# People

## Director
<div class="card-grid"><div class="person-card" style="grid-column: span 12;"><h3>Derek Van Berkel, PhD</h3><div class="person-role">Associate Professor · University of Michigan SEAS</div><p>Derek is a geographer and geospatial data scientist whose research examines climate adaptation and migration, urban and landscape change, participatory mapping, conservation, and environmental decision-making. He is Principal Investigator of GLISA, CLARS, and CHIRRP/PUMP-COR.</p><p>In 2026, he is a <strong>North America Visiting Fellow at the University of Helsinki</strong>, hosted by Prof. Enrico Di Minin.</p><p class="person-meta">dbvanber@umich.edu</p></div></div>
